headline: US-SAUDI NUKE DEAL SIGNS — Then Stalls: Trump Allows Kingdom to Enrich Uranium; Congress, Experts Alarmed
snippet: Trump signed a landmark 30-year nuclear cooperation agreement with Saudi Arabia on July 22 allowing the kingdom to enrich uranium domestically and build U.S.-supplied reactors — opening one of the world's largest prospective civilian nuclear markets to American companies and lifting long-term uranium demand expectations. By July 24, Al Jazeera reported the deal was still in limbo pending Congressional review, with proliferation experts warning the pact waives the 'golden standard' safeguards applied to Iran and could accelerate nuclear weapons ambitions across the Middle East; the Trump administration calls it a 'decades-long, multi-billion-dollar' partnership with significant benefits for U.S. reactor, engineering, and nuclear fuel-cycle contractors.

headline: SILVER CLAWS BACK $58.54 ON JULY 24 — Iran Lifts Brent $100+, FOMC Week Looms; Gold Holds $4,044
snippet: Silver recovered to $58.54/oz on July 24 (up 1.57%), clawing back most of Thursday's 3%+ selloff as physical buyers stepped in above $57; gold steadied at $4,044. The dominant driver is escalating Iran tensions — U.S. strikes on Iran and Houthi attacks on Red Sea tankers pushed Brent crude above $100/bbl for the first time since May, stiffening odds of a Fed rate hike at the July 28-29 FOMC meeting. Silver sits 52% below its January all-time high of $121.62 but is underpinned by a sixth consecutive annual supply deficit of 46.3 million ounces; the FOMC decision next week is the single most important near-term catalyst for precious metals direction.

headline: COPPER NEAR US RECORD: SHANGHAI DOWN 82%, PREMIUM DOUBLES — White House Tariff Decision Pending
snippet: Copper prices approached a new U.S. record this week as Shanghai Futures Exchange inventories crashed 82% since early May — one of the most rapid drawdown rates observed at a major exchange in recent years — while the spot cathode premium over SHFE futures spiked to 435 yuan/tonne, signalling extreme physical tightness in China's domestic copper supply chain. LME stocks fell 28% over the same period, and the New York COMEX premium widened to nearly $600/tonne as traders front-ran a potential White House decision to impose phased tariffs (15% from January 2027, rising to 30% in 2028) on refined copper imports — a call that now sits with the president after the Commerce Department's June report.

headline: DEFIANCE SILVER: 1,470 g/t Ag VEIN AT SAN ACACIO — Zacatecas MRE Campaign 6,132m Complete (TSXV: DEF)
snippet: Defiance Silver Corp. (TSXV: DEF) released July 23 an update from seven diamond drill holes totalling 1,700 metres at the San Acacio target of its Zacatecas Silver-Gold Project in Mexico, with the best intercept returning 1,470 g/t silver over 0.35 metres — results confirming structural extensions and validating the geological model ahead of a Mineral Resource Estimate. With 6,132 metres completed of a 10,000-metre 2026 program and assays pending from four additional holes (DDSA-26-89 to 26-92), Defiance is systematically building the dataset for a formal resource on a high-grade system in one of Mexico's most prolific silver districts.

headline: TIGER GOLD DRILLS 685m @ 0.6 g/t Au FROM SURFACE AT CEIBAL — Colombia Porphyry Open Beneath 800m (TSXV: TIGR)
snippet: Tiger Gold Corp. (TSXV: TIGR) reported July 23 that drillhole CEDDH-011 at the Ceibal target of its Quinchía Gold Project in Colombia's prolific Mid-Cauca gold belt intersected 685.35 metres grading 0.6 g/t gold from surface — with CEDDH-012 returning 568.4 metres at 0.6 g/t Au from 309.5 metres downhole, extending mineralisation to approximately 800 metres below surface. Elevated molybdenum at depth suggests the causative porphyry intrusion has not yet been intersected, leaving Ceibal open at depth; three rigs remain active across the project with assays pending from both Ceibal and the Tesorito target.

headline: TOCVAN HITS 581 g/t Ag AT SURFACE — New Zone 900m From Gran Pilar Pilot Plant; Q4 Production On Track (CSE: TOC)
snippet: Tocvan Ventures Corp. (CSE: TOC) announced July 23 the discovery of a new high-grade silver-gold zone at surface 900 metres east of its planned Gran Pilar Pilot Facility in Sonora, Mexico — hole JES-26-152 returning 1.5 metres at 2.2 g/t Au and 581 g/t Ag, confirming a robust vein system expandable close to existing infrastructure. With Pilot Facility construction advancing and first gold-silver doré production targeted for Q4 2026, the at-surface discovery adds near-mine resource optionality at a low-cost heap-leach project approaching first production.

headline: SILVER ACADIA: 3-KM MINERALIZED CORRIDOR CONFIRMED — Additional Phase 1 High-Grade Results at Nicholas-Denys (CSE: SLA)
snippet: Silver Acadia Exploration Inc. (CSE: SLA) released July 22 additional Phase 1 drill assays from the Hachey Zone at its Nicholas-Denys Project in northern New Brunswick, together with a structural study from Terrane Geoscience identifying a potentially 3-kilometre mineralized corridor hosting multiple high-grade silver-gold shoots within the Bathurst Mining Camp. The geological interpretation materially expands the mineralizing system's footprint beyond Phase 1's initial target area, setting up a Phase 2 program to test strike extensions across the full 3-km prospective trend.

headline: GOLDSILVER.COM: GOLD FELL 28% FROM JAN ATH — The Case Remains Intact; PBOC Bought the June Dip
snippet: GoldSilver.com's July 2026 gold price outlook argues that despite bullion's roughly 28% correction from January's all-time high — currently near $4,044 — the structural bull case is unchanged: the People's Bank of China added 15 tonnes in June (its largest purchase since 2023 and its 20th consecutive month of buying), de-dollarisation momentum continues, and U.S. fiscal deficit pressures are unaffected by near-term Fed rate-hike fears. The piece frames the current pullback as temporary volatility within a multi-year structural bull market and maintains its constructive medium-term price outlook.

headline: SILVER: 6TH CONSECUTIVE SUPPLY DEFICIT, 46.3M oz GAP — GoldSilver.com: FOMC Is The Catalyst; LBMA Targets $79
snippet: GoldSilver.com's July 2026 silver price outlook identifies two near-term catalysts from silver's current $58.55 level — 52% below January's record: the July 28-29 FOMC meeting (a rate hold eases real-yield pressure; a hike extends it) and the structural sixth consecutive annual supply deficit of 46.3 million ounces, driven by 58% industrial demand share from solar panels, electronics, and EVs. The LBMA 2026 analyst consensus price target is $79.57/oz; JPMorgan's base case is $81 — both implying 35%+ upside from current levels if the Fed pivots toward easing.

headline: CHINA BOUGHT THE DIP: PBOC ADDS 15 TONNES GOLD IN JUNE — 20 Straight Months of Buying Signals Structural Floor
snippet: Canadian Mining Report's July 24 analysis examines how China's PBOC added 14.93 tonnes of gold in June — its largest single-month purchase since 2023 and its 20th consecutive month of buying — during gold's worst quarterly decline in 13 years, demonstrating a structural de-dollarisation strategy that sets a persistent demand floor beneath spot prices. The piece argues this consistent central bank backstop, combined with rising renminbi-denominated gold demand as Chinese savers hedge property market weakness, is the structural signal Canadian junior mining investors should be pricing into long-duration gold project valuations.
